name: Sap Fiori Mcp Server
description: MCP server for SAP Fiori development tools for Claude Code. Build and modify SAP Fiori applications with AI assistance.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (7): `sap-fiori-add-visual-filter` (Add visual filters (chart-based) to SAP Fiori Elements filter bar/value help using CAP or ABAP RAP), `sap-fiori-analytical-chart` (Add analytical chart (chart + table hybrid) to SAP Fiori Elements List Report using aggregated data), `sap-fiori-app-development` (Guidelines for SAP Fiori app development for CAP and standalone projects), `sap-fiori-create-cli` (Run, invoke, and test the @sap-ux/create CLI — generate, add, convert, remove, update, change, list, get commands for…), `sap-fiori-eslint-plugin` (Configure, migrate, or run ESLint with @sap-ux/eslint-plugin-fiori-tools in SAP Fiori projects (standalone or CAP)), `sap-fiori-opa5-test-development` (Use this skill when writing, fixing, extending, or reviewing OPA5 integration tests for SAP Fiori Elements applications -…), `sap-fiori-tree-table` (Configure hierarchical tree table to SAP Fiori elements application for displaying parent-child recursive hierarchies)
- **MCP servers** (1): `fiori-mcp`

Installs with `claude plugin install sap-fiori-mcp-server@claude-plugins-official` from `SAP/open-ux-tools` (`packages/fiori-mcp-server`).
